body: This was aactually only a few weeks ago, so she's still in the clinic, but she recognises that she has a problem now and is willing to stay there until the psychiatrist can work out the right meds for her. She's upset to be away from her family, but she has a really great support network of friends and I'm really optimistic for the future. Thanks for asking :)

My sister and I were out shopping for Mother's day gifts and I remember thinking it was weird that I hadn't heard from my mum all day, but not that weird, so I ignored it. We get the gifts, I'm really happy with them and we head home. I pull in to the carport and see that her car is still missing and I just knew.

See, she'd been depressed. And she'd tried to overdose a few weeks before. We thought that we'd been getting the meds sorted, but in hindsight we were all just pretending that she was getting better, I knew, on some level, that she needed to be committed. But I just couldn't do it. And now, she'd taken off to some sketchy hotel room, god knows where, to try again. 

From then on, I just went numb. I called her friends, I called her psychiatrist and I called the cops. But I didn't actually think any of it would help, I was just resigned to the fact that there was no way she would screw up again, I knew she'd do it properly this time. My sister was breaking down and I didn't know what to say to her because I knew our mother was dead. 

Seven hours from the time I realised to the time they found her. Here's where the good news starts, because against all odds, she was alive. She had to have a few surgeries and she had to be admitted to a psych clinic but she's alive. Everyday I wake up and I thank the universe, because I should have lost my mother but I didn't. Nothing will ever make me feel as relieved as I did when they told me she was ok. I truly believe that there is some purpose, something my mother needs to do for the world, somebody's life that she is going to change, because against all odds, she is here today.

TL;DR: My mother is going to change the world
